Prashant Kumar

 9717685807	 prashantlucknow132@gmail.com	 

Experience

Oracle India	July 2022 – Present

Software Development Engineer III/SDE3/SDE III

Implemented DB Creation enhancement with db unique name and db name using DBCA oui and Fleet Maintenance OEM Database provisioning flow for both Native and SSA Cloud, reducing provisioning errors by 40%.

Implemented DB Image Creation for worldwide FPP and non FPP customers. This feature included the RU and Additional patches image management activity for all type of databases. Improving usability for 200K+ end users.

Re-define the Fleet Maintenance Rest API end points to follow the Open API standards. Understand the existing framework, implement the validation for different scenarios of DB Patching activities like update and upgrade.

Resolved 100% of Fortify-reported security issues, ensuring compliance and strengthening application security posture

LTI - Larsen & Toubro Infotech (Citi-Bank)	April 2021 – July 2022

Senior Software Engineer-Full Stack Development

Build high impact feature like automated change management tracker. Improved efficiency of systems like data set comparator by 60%.

Created data architecture using Protobuf (Google Data Object Model) to serialize objects for faster communication over the network. With the use of protobuf increased proficiency by 50%.

Worked on Creating CI/CD pipeline and openshift configuration for the project. Worked on SAST tools such as BlackDuck and Checkmarx to resolve the 50+ VA issues.

Mindgate Solution- Onsite State Bank of India	October 2020 – April 2021

Senior Software Engineer

Created features of tracking and managingData Reconciliation for credit & debit reversal, Deemed, DRC etc.

Created Scheduler Jobs for streamlining the posting of approval required data. Revamped four main pre-configured reports on the bases of transaction type. Increased proficiency by 50%.

Senior Analyst	September 2017 – October 2020

Senior Software Engineer

Designed code and workflow model for issue tracking and project management tool. Implemented configuration like dynamic forms, Taxonomy with Maker-Checker operations. Added Web Crawler for data processing.

Enhanced the product-customer engagement by implementing feature of User Journey tracking with various sets of analytics and social media tags, achieving a 40% increase in data extraction efficiency.

Personal Projects

Currency-Converter | Spring Boot, MySQL, JPA, Hibernate, HTML, CSS, JS (GitHub)	Dec 2022

This Currency Converter is the simplest, most efficient tool you’ll ever find. It supports over 150 different currencies from all around the world, with daily scheduled data refreshes, ensuring reliable, real-time pricing insights.

Technical Skills

Languages: Java, Python, C, JavaScript, SQL, Bash, HTML, CSS, Perl

Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Redis, MongoDB

Frameworks & Libraries: Spring Boot, Hibernate, JPA, Angular, Protobuf, Oracle JET/ ADE, Maven, Swagger, Junit. Technologies & Tools: Git, GitLab CI/CD, Postman, Linux, Regex, Data Structures & Algorithms,Problem Solving, REST API Development, Apache Kafka, Elasticsearch, AWS (EC2, Lambda, S3), OpenShift, Jenkins, Agile, Scrum Software Design: Microservices Architecture, System Design (HLD/LLD), Design Patterns, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Docker, Kubernetes

Achievements

∗ PG Diploma in Advance Computing from Centre for Development of Advanced Computing India year 2017.

∗ Oracle Innovation Award-2024 for innovative project for Automated Juint test code generation using e-CGEN

∗ Over 500+ problem solved on LeetCode with 150-day streak achieved and LeetCode rating of 1620.

∗ Star Performer of the Year and 2 Quarterly Spot Awards at eClerx and LTI for project enhancement and resolved critical security violation issue and Query optimization leading to a 15% boost in feature performance.

Education

Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University	July 2012 – June 2016

Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Computer Science and Engineering
